jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
  • Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
  • You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
  • You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
  • You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

  • Du rekrutierst, führst und entwickelst starke Führungskräfte und Spezialisten und baust eine Organisation, die nicht dauerhaft vom CPO abhängig ist.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den Gründern die langfristige Product- und Category Strategy und entscheidest, welche Kategorien, Silhouetten und Produktwelten Pammys zukünftig aufbaut.
  • Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der ersten Idee über Design, Construction, Material Selection, Sampling, Fit und Testing bis zur Serienproduktion und Markteinführung.
  • Du optimierst unsere Entwicklungsprozesse mit dem Ziel, Development Timelines zu verkürzen, Iterationen zu reduzieren und Produkte schneller zur Production Readiness zu bringen.
  • Du entwickelst unser internationales Factory- und Supplier Network weiter und führst strategische Verhandlungen zu Costing, Kapazitäten, Qualität, Lead Times und Produktionsbedingungen.
  • Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unsere Product-, Development- und Sourcing-Präsenz in China auf und entwickelst dort langfristig ein leistungsfähiges lokales Team.
  • Du etablierst klare QA- und QC-Strukturen und stellst sicher, dass definierte Qualitätsstandards nicht nur auf dem Papier existieren, sondern in der Produktion konsequent umgesetzt werden.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit Merchandising & Planning die kommerzielle Steuerung unseres Portfolios über Target Cost, Einkaufspreise, Verkaufspreise, Margen, Mengen, Launch-Zeitpunkte und Produktprofitabilität.

  • Du verknüpfst Produktentwicklung stärker mit Consumer Insights und Marketing und stellst sicher, dass neue Produkte auf reale Kundenbedürfnisse, klare Positionierung und kommerzielles Skalierungspotenzial ausgerichtet sind.
  • Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren Teams, Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in Asien und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Produkt- und Produktionsfragen ein.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf Director-, VP-, SVP- oder C-Level im Product-Bereich einer Footwear Brand oder eines vergleichbaren internationalen Consumer-Unternehmens.

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen schnell, datenbasiert und mit ausgeprägtem unternehmerischem Verständnis.

  • You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable

jobs.title: Product Engineer - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead, Agents
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Operations Lead to partner with the leadership team of one of Superhuman’s Business Units (BUs) to drive strategic clarity, operational alignment, and execution across the BU’s most important initiatives. Our BUs are led by an Engineering, Product, Design, and Marketing (EPDM) leadership team — with the Product leader as the point of the spear — and this role exists to make that BU and its leadership team successful as we expand our product portfolio in a compound-startup model.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and cross-functional execution. You will solid-line into the Strategy & Operations organization and dotted-line into your Business Unit, giving you both a durable operating craft and deep proximity to the leaders you serve. You’ll turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans, closing the gap between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution as a permanent operational partner to the team — not a project manager cycling through initiatives with a wind-down date. Your partners in this effort will span the company from other BUs to our Route-to-Market (RTM) teams and functional experts. It is truly an opportunity to have an outsized impact!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with your BU’s EPDM leadership team — anchored by the Product leader as the point of the spear — to turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans.

  • Plan and Track: run team-level planning, goal-setting, business reviews, and performance tracking connected to company-wide planning cycles, so leaders can focus on decision-making.

  • Special Projects: take dedicated ownership of the BU’s most complex, cross-functional initiatives so key efforts have a clear owner and don’t stall.

  • Ways of Working: build the rhythms, cadences, documentation, and tooling, so the team isn’t rebuilding its operating infrastructure from scratch each quarter or with each reorg.

  • Leadership Extension: represent your leaders in forums, cross-company meetings, and escalation paths as a trusted delegate — not just a coordinator — so key decisions don’t wait on calendar openings.

  • Partner across the company with other BUs, Route-to-Market (RTM) teams, and functional experts to have an outsize impact on the trajectory of our organization.

  • Facilitate strong information flow up, across, and down the organization to enable fast, informed decision-making in a matrixed, multi-product environment.

  • Drive operational readiness for new products, integrations, and cross-functional launches by coordinating planning and enablement across the BU and its RTM partners.

  • Independently drive initiatives day-to-day while scoping and partnering with the broader Strategy & Operations team for support on key motions.

Du siehst einen Trend und denkst nicht: „Das könnten wir auch machen.“

Was kommt danach? Was passt zu unserer Kundin? Und wie machen wir daraus etwas, das eindeutig Pammys ist?

Du hast ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Schuhe, Fashion, Farben, Materialien und Silhouetten und gleichzeitig genug kommerzielles Verständnis, um zu wissen, dass ein großartiges Produkt nicht nur auf einem Moodboard funktionieren muss.

Es muss gekauft werden.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende daran, aus Pammys eine internationale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Mit unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase bauen wir unser Produktportfolio deutlich aus und entwickeln Pammys von einzelnen erfolgreichen Produkten zu einer starken internationalen Footwear Brand.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Footwear Designer (m/w/d), der unsere zukünftigen Kollektionen und Produkte maßgeblich mitgestaltet.

Du bekommst keine fertigen Ideen zum Ausarbeiten.

Wir erwarten, dass die besten Ideen von dir kommen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung neuer Footwear-Konzepte, Modelle und Kollektionen von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Design

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Frontend Engineer to own the front end at Omnea.

Our design system is growing fast, our front-end architecture is becoming more complex, and right now ownership of these things is distributed. You'd be the person who takes this to the next level.

You'll work across every product team. You'll own the design system, own the front-end architecture, and set the standard for how we build interfaces. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple. The front end has to scale with it.

This is a craft role with real leverage. Almost every engineer at Omnea ships front end. What you build determines how well they do it.

Procurement is a harder interface problem than it sounds. Approval workflows that branch and re-route, dense tables people live in all day, intake forms that adapt to what someone is buying. Getting this right is the difference between software people tolerate and software people actually like using.

What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?

  • Join a Skilled Team. Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers and product designers from top technology businesses and startups.

  • Own the Design System. You'll own our design system outright: components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Design to turn intent into reusable, high-quality primitives.

  • Own the Front-End Architecture. Deployment strategy, performance, build tooling, and the conventions everyone else follows. You'll set the direction rather than inherit it, working alongside the engineers and designers closest to each surface rather than owning it in isolation.

  • Leverage Across Every Team. You'll work with all of our engineering teams on their most front-end-heavy projects. The work you do multiplies across the whole org.

  • A Real Design Partnership. Every cross-functional team at Omnea has a dedicated Product Manager and Product Designer. You'll be the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships, and the person designers come to when they want to know what's possible.

  • Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript everywhere, React and Next.js on the front end, and Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, so you can refactor the design system without fear. Behind it sits Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions, with Datadog for observability.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.

  • Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.

  • Collaboration and Autonomy. We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.

  • Customers at the Center. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.


About You

  • You're deep in React. You've built complex, production React applications and you understand the framework properly, not just the API surface. Rendering behaviour, state, performance, and where things break at scale.

  • You've owned front-end infrastructure. Rendering strategies, build tooling, bundle performance, and the architectural decisions underneath a large application.

  • You've built or owned a design system. Not just consumed one. You've made the calls on component APIs, driven adoption across teams, and dealt with the messy reality of migration and versioning.

  • You have taste. You care how things look and feel, you notice when something is only 90% right, and you can hold a genuine conversation with designers rather than just implementing tickets.

  • You know CSS deeply. Layout, styling architecture, and building interfaces that hold up across breakpoints, themes, and edge cases. You treat accessibility and motion as part of the craft rather than a checklist at the end.

  • You're a strong engineer first. Your depth and your interest sit in the front end, and that's the point of this role. But you're fluent in TypeScript generally and comfortable working beyond the browser when a problem calls for it.

  • You're motivated by impact. You care about what your work actually achieves, not just how it's built. You thrive with the autonomy to make meaningful decisions and take real ownership of outcomes.

jobs.description:
Stora is looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of the sales function as the business moves into its next stage of growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-the-sidelines one.

There is already a product customers want, an established position in the UK and Ireland, growing European opportunity, and a sales team in place. The challenge now is to turn that foundation into a more predictable, repeatable commercial engine.

You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit.

The opportunity

Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before.

The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like:

  • Where should the team focus its time and why?

  • How does outbound become consistently productive?

  • Where are deals getting stuck?

  • How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed?

  • Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities?

  • What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally?

  • How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on?

This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results.

What you’ll own

  • Sales strategy and execution

  • Leadership, coaching and development of the SDR and AE team

  • Outbound performance and pipeline generation

  • Sales process from first engagement through to closed-won

  • Forecasting, pipeline health and revenue visibility

  • Performance management and clear expectations across the team

  • Key and strategically important opportunities where senior involvement can make a difference

  • Close alignment with Marketing and Product around ICP, messaging, customer insight and market opportunity

You’ll also stay close to customers and deals.

Stora wants a sales leader who knows what is happening on the ground, not someone whose understanding of the market comes entirely from dashboards and weekly reports.

What a strong candidate looks like

Stora needs a hands-on B2B SaaS sales leader who can build consistent performance, not just manage what already exists.

You’re likely someone who:

  • Has a genuine hunter mentality and knows how to create pipeline, not just manage what lands

  • Has led and developed SaaS sales teams and can raise the standard of performance around them

  • Knows what good outbound looks like and can coach it properly

  • Has personally sold into SMB and/or mid-market customers and can still step into important deals when needed

  • Builds healthier, more predictable pipeline and brings strong forecasting discipline

  • Qualifies hard, prioritises well and is comfortable walking away from weak opportunities

  • Uses data to improve decisions without hiding behind dashboards

  • Challenges assumptions, spots where the sales motion is weak and acts on it

  • Sets clear expectations, coaches directly and holds people accountable

  • Can move comfortably between commercial strategy with the CEO, coaching the team and getting involved in a deal that matters

  • Has the commercial instinct to spot new segments, markets or opportunities worth pursuing

This is still a stage where leadership means building as well as leading. If you want to inherit a large sales organisation, established territories and a finished playbook, this probably is not the role.

Experience in vertical SaaS, operationally complex industries or international markets would be useful, but none are essential.

Why Stora

Stora builds the software self storage operators use to run and grow their businesses, covering areas including bookings, payments, facility management, reporting and automation.

The business has established strong traction in the UK and Ireland and is continuing to expand across Europe and other international markets.

For a Head of Sales, that creates an interesting point to join:

  • A proven product rather than an early experiment

  • Existing customers and market credibility

  • A sales team already in place

  • Significant European market opportunity ahead

  • Direct access to the CEO and leadership team

  • The ability to meaningfully shape commercial strategy

  • Share options and genuine participation in the upside created

The foundations exist. The opportunity is to build what comes next.

Location

Stora operates as a distributed business across the UK and Europe.

Being based in Northern Ireland would be particularly useful given the proximity to the CEO and leadership team, although strong candidates elsewhere in the UK or EU will absolutely be considered.

What Stora offers

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission plan

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • Apple hardware

  • Work from home budget

  • Learning and development support

  • Regular in-person team events and company meet-ups

Next steps

Applications are reviewed as they come in and Stora will move quickly where there is a strong fit.

Equal opportunities

Stora is committed to creating a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect.

Applications are welcomed from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment decisions are based on merit, capability and business need.

If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let the team know.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer | Developer Experience
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

You will join the Developer Experience track, whose customers are DeepL's own engineers. Every change that reaches our products, from a research prototype to a production release, travels through the platform, pipelines and workflows this track owns. Our job is to make that journey fast, safe and obvious, so that engineers spend their time on the problems only they can solve.

That ownership runs the full width of the developer's day. It covers the foundation: source control, the CI and CD fleet that runs every pipeline across Kubernetes, macOS and Windows, build and dependency caching, and the artifact and package registries that hold what we ship. Having recently moved our source and CI onto GitLab SaaS, we are now shaping what a genuinely self-service platform looks like on top of it.

It also covers everything an engineer actually touches: our internal developer portal and service catalogue in Backstage, the Golden Path templates and release automation that make the right thing the easy thing, automated guardrails for security and production readiness, self-service access management, and the AI tooling our engineers use every day, including AI-assisted code review. We measure whether any of it is working, through developer surveys and delivery metrics.

We treat developer experience as a product, not a support function. We are opinionated about paved roads, allergic to mandates without migration paths, and increasingly focused on a question the whole industry is still answering: what does an engineering organisation look like when AI is a first-class part of how software gets built?

Your responsibilities

  • Own technical direction for a significant part of the Developer Experience mandate. Identify where the biggest friction sits for our engineers, form a clear position on how to remove it, and see that work through to adoption.

  • Lead initiatives that lift developer productivity across multiple engineering teams, by understanding and improving processes and tooling, and by drawing on both established software engineering practice and AI capability.

  • Design and build the workflows and tooling that carry a change through the software development lifecycle, from local development through review to release.

  • Lead our work on AI across that lifecycle. Evaluate what genuinely helps, build the guardrails that make it safe and useful at our scale, and be candid about what does not work.

  • Treat internal developers as customers and grow a community around developer experience. Talk to them, watch where they struggle, and let evidence decide what to build and whether it landed, whether that evidence is survey data, delivery metrics or support load. Empower product teams to own their delivery journey, and turn consensus across engineering into shipped change. Much of the work at this level is influence without authority.

  • Define standards that hold across the track and drive migrations to them, bringing teams along with a working path rather than a deadline.

  • Mentor engineers across the track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep systems maintainable.

  • Share in operating what we build, including a sustainable on call rotation for the services and tooling other teams rely on.

Qualities we look for

  • A software engineering background, in any language, with real depth in at least one. We genuinely do not mind which: C#, Go, TypeScript and Python are all well represented here. We care that you can build software other engineers rely on, and that you can read your way into an unfamiliar codebase.

  • Time in a product team, shipping to external customers. The best developer experience work comes from people who have personally felt the pipeline they are now redesigning, and who know what a product team is actually optimising for.

  • Genuine passion for developer experience. Build systems, CI and CD, internal platforms, release engineering, and the texture of what makes a codebase pleasant or miserable to work in. This is a role for someone who finds this intrinsically interesting, not a stepping stone.

  • Enthusiasm for figuring out where AI creates real leverage in how software gets built, a willingness to run experiments that fail, and enough scepticism to tell the difference between a genuine improvement and a demo.

  • A track record of technical ownership spanning several teams. You create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear positions, change them on evidence, and carry other engineers with you.

  • The judgement to trade the ideal solution for one you can ship and iterate on, and the tenacity to keep going. Changing how an engineering organisation works is a long game, and adoption is the hard part.

You would get bonus points for

  • Measuring developer productivity credibly, through DORA, developer surveys, or your own defensible approach.

  • Having built or operated AI-assisted developer tooling: code review, agents, MCP servers, or evaluation of any of the above.

  • Experience building an internal developer platform or portal, especially with Backstage.

  • Community building you can point to. Open source maintainership, a guild or community of practice, developer advocacy, or any place you have grown adoption and ownership rather than mandated it.

  • GitLab or comparable CI and CD at scale, and build system work on large polyglot codebases. Runner fleets, pipeline performance, caching and artifacts, and compile and test time optimisation.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Director of Corporate Development
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional Corporate Development role.

As Director of Corporate Development, you will work directly with the CEO and take responsibility for building Andercore's M&A engine from the ground up. You will help define our roll-up strategy, identify and approach acquisition targets, develop investment cases and execute transactions end-to-end. At the same time, you will work closely with our technology and operating teams to answer the question at the heart of our strategy:

How can we acquire traditional industrial businesses and use technology and AI to make them dramatically better?

This means thinking beyond financial engineering and traditional buy-and-build.

You will help identify where AI, automation, centralized procurement, data, pricing, sales productivity, working-capital optimization and shared infrastructure can fundamentally improve the economics of acquired businesses.

Your mandate is ultimately to build a repeatable acquisition and value-creation machine capable of executing multiple transactions every year.

What You Will Own

M&A & Roll-Up Strategy

  • Take Andercore's acquisition and consolidation strategy across Europe to the next level.

  • Identify attractive verticals, geographies and acquisition archetypes.

  • Build market maps and identify highly fragmented markets suitable for consolidation.

  • Develop the financial and strategic logic behind our roll-up thesis.

  • Determine where Andercore's technology and AI capabilities can create disproportionate value after acquisition.

  • Build a multi-year acquisition roadmap together with the CEO and Board.

Proprietary Deal Origination

  • Build and continuously develop a proprietary pipeline of acquisition opportunities.

  • Identify and directly approach founders and owners of attractive businesses.

  • Build trusted relationships with entrepreneurs, often long before they consider selling.

  • Develop systematic, data-driven sourcing approaches.

  • Build relationships with investment banks, M&A boutiques, advisers and other intermediaries.

We expect proprietary sourcing to become a core competitive advantage of Andercore's M&A strategy.

Deal Execution

Own transactions from first conversation through closing:

  • Initial assessment and strategic fit

  • Financial analysis and valuation

  • Investment cases

  • Deal structuring

  • LOIs

  • Negotiation

  • Commercial, financial, tax and legal due diligence

  • Financing

  • Board and shareholder materials

  • Signing and closing

You will coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisers while remaining personally accountable for moving transactions forward.

AI-Driven Value Creation

Our ambition is not simply to acquire businesses. It is to transform them.

Together with Andercore's technology and operating teams, you will identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and our central platform across areas such as:

  • Sales productivity and customer intelligence

  • Pricing and margin optimization

  • Procurement

  • Supplier management

  • Customer service

  • Finance and administration

  • Working capital

  • Logistics and fulfilment

  • Data and reporting

You will incorporate these opportunities into acquisition theses and quantify their potential impact before we invest.

Integration & Portfolio Value Creation

  • Develop Day-1 and 100-day plans before closing.

  • Translate investment theses into measurable operational initiatives.

  • Define integration priorities together with functional leaders.

  • Track acquisition performance against the original investment case.

  • Identify additional opportunities for technology deployment, synergies and operational improvement.

The objective is not necessarily to integrate everything immediately. It is to determine what should be centralized, what should remain entrepreneurial and where Andercore's platform creates the greatest advantage.

Build the M&A Machine

You will build the infrastructure required to turn acquisitions into a repeatable capability using the latest AI stack:

  • M&A playbook

  • Target database and pipeline

  • Valuation frameworks

  • Investment committee processes

  • Due diligence standards

  • Deal documentation

  • Integration playbooks

  • Portfolio reporting

  • Value-creation tracking

As our acquisition pace increases, you will build and lead a dedicated Corporate Development team.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an exceptional investor and operator. The strongest candidates will likely come from:

  • Leading Private Equity funds, particularly buy-and-build or mid-market investing

  • Top-tier Investment Banking / M&A

  • Corporate Development at a highly acquisitive company

  • A combination of Investment Banking and Private Equity

You will likely bring 5–10 years of relevant experience, including meaningful exposure to transactions.

Experience in industrial distribution, business services, industrial technology or fragmented-market consolidation is particularly valuable.

You combine:

  • Exceptional financial and analytical capabilities

  • Strong commercial judgment

  • Deep understanding of M&A

  • Excellent negotiation skills

  • Entrepreneurial instinct

  • High ownership and execution intensity

  • Ability to build relationships with entrepreneurs and business owners

  • Intellectual curiosity around AI and technology

You do not need to be an AI engineer.

But you should be deeply interested in understanding how AI changes businesses, cost structures and competitive advantages — and how those changes can create entirely new acquisition strategies.

German and English fluency are highly preferred.

Who You Are

  • You think like an investor but operate like an entrepreneur.

  • You enjoy understanding businesses quickly and identifying what makes them valuable.

  • You are comfortable calling a founder yourself, building the model yourself, negotiating an LOI and presenting the investment case to the Board.

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. To this date, we have organically launched six companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

As our B2B Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You'll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You'll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.

  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you're equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands' progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

jobs.title: Dev/Ops Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Cloud Plattform gestalten: Sie bauen eine moderne Azure Cloud und Container Umgebung für geschäftskritische, selbst entwickelte Anwendungen auf und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter
  • Migration vorantreiben: Sie begleiten die Transformation bestehender Docker und On Premises Umgebungen in eine skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Azure Infrastruktur
  • Container orchestrieren: Sie betreiben und optimieren containerisierte Anwendungen und arbeiten dabei mit Technologien wie Docker, Kubernetes und Azure Kubernetes Service
  • Deployments automatisieren: Sie entwickeln und optimieren CI/CD Pipelines und sorgen für automatisierte, zuverlässige und reproduzierbare Deployments
  • Infrastructure as Code etablieren: Sie automatisieren die Bereitstellung und Konfiguration von Infrastruktur, beispielsweise mit Terraform, Bicep oder vergleichbaren Technologien
  • Stabilität sicherstellen: Sie verantworten gemeinsam mit dem Team den zuverlässigen Betrieb der Anwendungen und stellen Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Skalierbarkeit der Plattform sicher
  • Monitoring weiterentwickeln: Sie implementieren technische und fachliche Monitoring Checks, erkennen Störungen frühzeitig und schaffen Transparenz über Performance und Stabilität der Systeme
  • Probleme nachhaltig lösen: Sie analysieren Fehler und Störungen bis auf Infrastruktur und Anwendungsebene und entwickeln gemeinsam mit Entwicklung und Betrieb nachhaltige Lösungen
  • DevOps Kultur leben: Sie arbeiten eng mit Softwareentwicklung, Cloud Engineering und weiteren IT Bereichen zusammen und treiben Automatisierung, Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung aktiv voran.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil

  • DevOps Erfahrung: Sie verfügen über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
  • Azure Expertise: Sie kennen Microsoft Azure sehr gut und haben praktische Erfahrung beim Aufbau oder Betrieb produktiver Cloud Umgebungen
  • Container Know how: Docker gehört zu Ihrem täglichen Werkzeugkasten, idealerweise bringen Sie zusätzlich praktische Erfahrung mit Kubernetes beziehungsweise Azure Kubernetes Service mit
  • CI/CD Kompetenz: Sie haben Erfahrung mit automatisierten Build, Test und Deployment Prozessen sowie dem Aufbau und der Pflege entsprechender Pipelines
  • Automatisierung: Infrastructure as Code ist für Sie kein Fremdwort, Kenntnisse in Terraform, Bicep, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen sind besonders willkommen
  • Monitoring Verständnis: Sie wissen, wie produktive Systeme sinnvoll überwacht werden und haben Erfahrung mit Monitoring, Logging und der Analyse von Performanceproblemen
  • Technisches Verständnis: Grundkenntnisse in SQL, Netzwerken sowie Linux und Windows Infrastrukturen helfen Ihnen dabei, Probleme auch über Systemgrenzen hinweg zu analysieren
  • Entwicklungsnähe: Sie müssen kein Softwareentwickler sein, können sich aber gut in moderne Anwendungsarchitekturen hineinversetzen, Erfahrung im Umfeld von C#, React oder VueJS ist von Vorteil
  • Arbeitsweise: Sie denken analytisch, arbeiten strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und haben Freude daran, bestehende Lösungen nicht nur zu betreiben, sondern kontinuierlich zu verbessern
  • Kommunikation: Sie verfügen über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden technischen Bereichen und der Fertigung, um eine effiziente und praxisnahe Entwicklung sicherzustellen

  • Strategische Mitgestaltung: Aktive Mitarbeit im erweiterten Führungskreis sowie Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung der technischen und organisatorischen Ausrichtung des Engineering-Bereichs

Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you. 


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:  

Must have:
• Architectural knowledge for complex, distributed systems 
• Solid understanding of the hosting domain – you know what happens behind a VPS booking 
• Systems modelling with UML, C4, BPMN, ERD, or FMC (e.g. Drawio, Visio, Mermaid) 
• 5+ years of experience, with 2+ years focused on architecture 
• Fluent in German and English 
 
Should have: 
• Experience with Kubernetes, Ansible, or comparable IaC tools 
• Some or deep experience migrating monolithic systems to microservices 
• Mentoring background 
 
Nice to have: 
• AI tools in everyday development (e.g. Claude Code) 
 
We're filling this role at two levels. See where you recognise yourself: 
 
Senior - You own the full architecture responsibility and set the standard for all teams. 

  • 7+ years of experience, 2+ in the industry

  • You define processes and drive them with the team

Mid-Level - You grow into architectural responsibility – with real scope and clear support. 
  • 5+ years of experience, 2+ years with architecture focus

  • Interest in mentoring and knowledge sharing
  • Openness to learningnew technologies
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

Du löst das Problem.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende daran, aus Pammys eine internationale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Du verantwortest das gesamte Marketing als Wachstumsmotor des Unternehmens – mit voller Budget- und Ergebnisverantwortung, direktem Draht zu den beiden Gründern und der Führung eines Teams von über 50 Menschen. Performance Marketing. Influencer & Creator. Du führst und skalierst unser Influencer-Geschäft – eines der größten im Land, mit eigenem Team, klarer Erfolgsmessung pro Kooperation und Creator-Content als Treibstoff für Paid. Hier entsteht ein Großteil unseres Wachstums, und du machst daraus ein noch schärferes System.
Creative Engine. Du verantwortest unsere Content- und Creative-Produktion: hohe Schlagzahl, systematisches Testing, klare Erfolgsmuster. Du weißt, dass im D2C das Creative der größte Hebel im Account ist – und baust die Struktur, die jede Woche neue Gewinner liefert.
Internationalisierung. Du bringst unser Marketing-Playbook in neue Märkte – von der Lokalisierung der Creatives über den Aufbau lokaler Creator-Netzwerke bis zur profitablen Skalierung vor Ort. Gemeinsam mit unserem COO, der die operative Seite verantwortet.
Retention & Brand. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Käufern Wiederkäufer werden – CRM, E-Mail, Community – und entwickelst unsere Marke weiter, ohne dass sie ihre Herkunft verliert: nahbar, ehrlich, für Menschen, die den ganzen Tag auf den Beinen sind.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Führungserfahrung mit Organisationen von 50+ Menschen über mehrere Teams hinweg – und die Fähigkeit, Top-Leute anzuziehen und zu halten
  • Du bist Operator, kein Verwalter: Du gehst selbst ins Ad-Konto, in die Creatives, in die Daten

Dein Profil

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der profitablen Steuerung und Skalierung siebenstelliger monatlicher Paid-Media-Budgets
  • Tiefes Verständnis von Performance Marketing, Creative Strategy, Influencer Marketing und Retention als integrierte Wachstumstreiber
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Deckungsbeitrag, CAC, Neukunden-Ökonomie und Wiederkaufrate
  • Erfahrung in der Führung größerer, multidisziplinärer Marketing-Organisationen mit mehreren Teams und Führungskräften
  • Ausgeprägtes Creative- und Performance-Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Daten, Creatives und Kampagnen selbst operativ zu challengen
  • Erfahrung in der Internationalisierung und Skalierung von Marketing-Playbooks in neue Märkte
  • Hoher unternehmerischer Drive, starke Entscheidungsfähigkeit und ein klarer Operator-Mindset sowie verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Die Führung einer Marketing-Maschine, die bereits bewiesen hat, dass sie skaliert – du baust auf Stärke, nicht auf Hoffnung
  • Volle Ownership über Budget, Teams und Roadmap – Entscheidungen fallen in Stunden, nicht in Gremien

  • Gestaltungsspielraum beim Ausbau unseres Banking-Beratungsportfolios

SetSales is Northern Europe's leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. 

What we offer you

As our Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You'll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You'll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you're equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands' progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, D2C
Strategy & Operations Manager, Customer Experience
jobs.description:
About the team

As one of DoorDash's core operations teams, Customer Experience ensures that when there are bumps in the last mile, there's always someone there to help make things right. Our team designs and implements DoorDash's automated support solutions, with the ultimate goal of delivering an outstanding customer experience as reliably and efficiently as possible.

About the role

Our team is looking to hire a Manager to lead the expansion of support automation in international markets. This Manager will own the end-to-end strategy and implementation of automated support features across new markets — leveraging DoorDash's extensive automation expertise to drive measurable automated resolution rate while building a scalable foundation for ongoing global expansion.

This Manager will serve as the S&O Expansion Program Lead: the central DRI for developing DoorDash's international automation rollout plan, owning reporting for North Star metric, and working closely with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and country teams. This role is a great opportunity for someone who wants to operationalize complex, multi-market solutions and have a direct impact on DoorDash's global support strategy

What you'll be doing

  • Lead strategy. Define and drive DoorDash's support automation expansion strategy for international markets: determining use cases, prioritization frameworks, and the approach to scaling automations across countries in a repeatable, compliant, and operationally efficient way.

  • Own the metric. Own the goal end-to-end, tracking progress weekly, identifying gaps, and driving corrective action across the cross-functional team.

  • Build the foundation. Build a strong foundation partnering with Product and Engineering to enable feature parity and market customization, and creating the playbook for scaling across new use cases and automation channels.

jobs.description:
The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, audio technology, and product quality.

You have a strong engineering mindset, deep curiosity about how complex systems behave, and practical experience testing audio software in real-world environments. You are comfortable working close to the code, designing robust test automation, debugging across software and hardware boundaries, and helping teams build products that are reliable, observable, and easy to validate.

At HOLOPLOT, software is central to the design, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operation of sound systems.

Our show production team has been working on a wide range of audio applications/plugins for immersive audio content production that will work hand in hand with our sound system. Testing such applications and plugins requires more than checking whether features work. It requires an understanding of signal flow, timing, synchronization, real-time constraints, interoperability, and how audio systems fail in practice. It also requires creating representable mocks and setups that are effective, economical, and maintainable.


Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test in this team, you will partner closely with software engineers and product designers to define test strategies, build automation, and validate complex workflows across desktop applications, audio plugins, networked audio systems, and spatial audio features. You will develop automated, scalable test frameworks, explore test infrastructure, and increase confidence in release cycles.

You will work on both black-box and white-box testing approaches, depending on the problem: from backend-driven end-to-end tests to signal-analysis-based tests, UI validation, and system-level regression tests.

You will help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability, runtime, debuggability, and maintainability of the test suite.

You will create test tools that make it easier to automatically capture, analyze, compare, and validate audio behavior.

You will help teams move from manual validation toward reproducible, deterministic, and observable test workflows.


What you need to succeed in this role

Your skills and qualifications

  • A proven track record as a Software Development Engineer in Test, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on quality and automation.

  • Professional experience in the audio industry, preferably overlapping with the following fields: desktop audio applications, audio plugins, Audio-over-IP, spatial audio and immersive sound experience, embedded audio systems.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language such as Python.

  • Knowledge of C++ with a wish to learn more.

  • Experience designing and maintaining automated test frameworks, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and CI-based validation workflows.

  • A good understanding of digital audio fundamentals.

  • Experience testing desktop applications, in all major platforms.

  • Experience with audio plugin testing.

  • Good understanding of software architecture, testability, observability, and maintainable engineering practices.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain technical risks, test strategies, and failure modes clearly to developers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • An eye for detail, a tad of perfectionism, a can-do mentality, and the courage to take on new challenges

  • A mindset of curiosity and excellence

  • Positive vibes and desire to contribute to a productive and collegial working environment


Nice to haves

  • Experience with networked audio or real-time network protocols is highly valuable, especially AES67, Ravenna, Dante, RTP, PTP, multicast, or related technologies.

  • Experience with spatial audio technologies.

  • Experience testing multi-channel audio systems or large-scale professional audio installations.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.
